content: 1. Telmisartan tablets USP 80 mg are white to off-white, capsule-shaped tablets. One side is engraved with the letter 'G,' and the other side is engraved with the number '201.' 2. These tablets are available in bottles of 100 (NDC 68462-201-01) or in cartons of 30 tablets (3 x 10 unit-dose) (NDC 68462-201-13). 3. It is important to read the patient information leaflet before starting telmisartan tablets and each time you get a refill, as there may be new information. 4. This information does not replace discussions with your doctor about your medical condition or treatment. 5. Telmisartan tablets can cause harm or death to an unborn baby. 6. 7. If you become pregnant while taking telmisartan tablets, inform your doctor immediately. 8. 9. The safety and effectiveness of telmisartan tablets in children have not been established. 10. Do not take telmisartan tablets if you are allergic to telmisartan or any of the other ingredients listed in the leaflet. 11. If you have diabetes and are taking telmisartan, you should not take aliskiren. 12. Before taking telmisartan tablets, inform your doctor if you have liver problems, kidney problems, heart problems, or any other medical conditions. 13. If you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, see the section on the most important information about telmisartan tablets. 14. If you are breastfeeding or planning to breastfeed, it is not known if telmisartan passes into breast milk. 15. You and your doctor should decide whether you will take telmisartan tablets or breastfeed, but you should not do both. 16. Discuss the best way to feed your baby with your doctor if you are taking telmisartan tablets. 17. Inform your doctor about all the medications you are taking, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, vitamins, and herbal supplements. 18. Telmisartan tablets may interact with other medications, affecting how they work or how telmisartan works. 19. 20. Keep a list of all your medications and share it with your doctor or pharmacist when starting a new medication. 21. Take telmisartan tablets exactly as prescribed by your doctor. 22. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dose and timing for you. 23. Do not change your dose unless instructed by your doctor. 24. Take telmisartan tablets once daily at the same time each day, with or without food. 25. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to your next dose, skip the missed dose and take the next dose at your regular time. 26. If you take too much telmisartan, contact your doctor or go to the nearest hospital emergency room immediately. 27. Refer to the How to Open the Blister section in the leaflet before using telmisartan tablets. 28. Consult your doctor if you do not understand the instructions. 29. 30. 31. If you feel faint or dizzy, lie down and contact your doctor immediately. 32. Kidney problems may worsen if you already have kidney disease. Your doctor may adjust your dose or monitor your kidney function. 33. Contact your doctor if you experience swelling in your feet, ankles, or hands, or unexplained weight gain. 34. Your doctor may check your potassium levels as needed. 35. Rare allergic reactions may include swelling of the face, tongue, or throat, difficulty breathing, or a skin rash. Contact your doctor immediately if you experience these symptoms. 36. Common side effects of telmisartan tablets include sinus pain and congestion (sinusitis), back pain, and diarrhea. 37. Inform your doctor if you experience any bothersome or persistent side effects. 38. For medical advice about side effects, contact your doctor or report them to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088. 39. Store telmisartan tablets at 59°F to 86°F (15°C to 30°C). 40. Do not remove telmisartan tablets from their blister packaging until just before use. 41. Keep telmisartan tablets and all medications out of the reach of children. 42. Medications are sometimes prescribed for purposes not listed in the patient information leaflet. 43. Do not use telmisartan tablets for a condition for which they were not prescribed. 44. Do not share telmisartan tablets with others, even if they have the same condition, as it may harm them. 45. This leaflet summarizes the most important information about telmisartan tablets. For more information, consult your doctor or pharmacist. 46. You can also contact Glenmark Generics Inc., USA, at 1-888-721-7115 or visit their website at www.glenmarkgenerics.com. 47. The active ingredient in telmisartan tablets is telmisartan USP. 48. Inactive ingredients include crospovidone, lactose monohydrate, magnesium stearate, meglumine, povidone, and sodium hydroxide pellets. 49. 50. 51. 52. 53. To open the blister, tear it apart (scissors may be used), peel off the paper layer from the aluminum foil, and push the tablet through the foil.
